value.text: Live mode truncates the coordinate toward zero to four decimal places and supplies it as lat/lon to https://api.met.no/weatherapi/locationforecast/2.0/compact?lat=$lat&lon=$lon. Fixture mode reads /app/fixtures/{place.id}.json instead. For the supported Oslo coordinates, the constructed URL is https://api.met.no/weatherapi/locationforecast/2.0/compact?lat=59.9300&lon=10.7200 (static example, not an observed request).
